findings.detail: Twenty-three rows flagged by PP03 are December 31, 2025 comparative schedule positions retained under the March 31, 2026 report_date.

citation.quoted_text: Consolidated Schedules of Investments as of March 31, 2026 (unaudited) and December 31, 2025

rationale: PP03 is a real data error. The source filing explicitly contains schedules for both March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025. The flagged rows are described in the review artifact as source-period-earlier-than-report-date records, and raw source confirms a comparative schedule block: table 116 totals to the December 31, 2025 fair value of 21,508,598.4, while representative flagged issuer ZocDoc appears in that comparative block at table 80 row 34. Current-period holdings for report_date 2026-03-31 should not retain those December 31, 2025 comparative-period rows.
